content.thinking: That's a test bug: "from-bare" uses `mk(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test")` but the expected `expw()` default includes ";tag=q7". Let me fix the expectation.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
p=open('tmp/t5.py').read()
p=p.replace('wcheck("from-bare", mk(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test"), expw())',
            'wcheck("from-bare", mk(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test"),\n       expw(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>"))')
open('tmp/t5.py','w').write(p)
EOF
python3 tmp/t5.py
